A tiny speck below the end of the word (x≈2030, y≈2855) looks like an ink spot, not a letter or diacritic. There is no shelfmark, date or extent.

A pencil 'h/?' sits at x≈2884–3014, y≈4011–4201. There is a dot beneath the 'h', a long slash, and a question mark with its dot. No catalogue entry on this page is near it. It is correctly kept as an unattached annotation. A similar pencil 'h/?' appears in the left margin of fol. 278.
